subject.title: fix(reef): repeated relay reconnects no longer leave stale sockets active

question: Should Reef accept waiting for the real `ws` close event—potentially about 30 seconds for an unresponsive peer—to guarantee that no replacement socket overlaps a failed generation?
rationale: The patch deliberately exchanges faster recovery for a stronger no-overlap invariant; repository policy treats availability-affecting fallback and shutdown behavior as an owner decision rather than an implementation-only choice.

options.title: Accept native close wait
options.body: Retain the close-before-reconnect invariant and accept the native `ws` close-timeout delay for peers that do not complete the closing handshake.

options.title: Define a different recovery contract
options.body: Specify an owner-approved bounded recovery mechanism and its injected-socket/test contract before changing the implementation further.

recommendation.title: Accept native close wait
recommendation.body: Retain the close-before-reconnect invariant and accept the native `ws` close-timeout delay for peers that do not complete the closing handshake.
